scope: Placement and contribution audit only: 296 entries newly assessed and 33 prior placement decisions carried forward. Learner text and original language reviews are unchanged. The audit preserves heterogeneous lexical evidence strength and does not claim fresh source verification, native review, or an official word-level CEFR assignment.

criteria: Source sense and learner content must have no unresolved non-placement findings.
The actual supplied definition and example must support a specific nuance, register function, idiomatic or figurative use, or useful precise cultural distinction.
Compare the learning contribution with actual earlier-course and C2-draft coverage; absence alone is insufficient.
Neither a formal/rare label nor an unsupported C1 assertion decides inclusion.
Do not credit unwritten senses or count transparent related forms without a distinct learning contribution.
